title: 增透膜設計與沉積~Antireflection coating design and deposition
focus: 用導納匹配設計單層、V 形與寬帶增透膜，並把沉積、量測與鏡頭鬼影預算串成可驗收的工程~Designing single-layer, V-coat and broadband antireflection films by admittance matching and tying deposition, metrology and lens ghost budgets into acceptable engineering
summary: 從 Fresnel 反射與多片鏡頭的穿透率損失出發，用導納匹配條件推導 MgF₂ 單層、四分之一波雙層 V 膜與四分之一／半波／四分之一寬帶膜的殘餘反射率，再討論低折射率膜材與熱基板蒸鍍、透鏡上的厚度分佈、低反射率量測的背面陷阱、入射角與偏振的影響，最後把殘餘反射換算成鏡頭鬼影與穿透率預算並完成驗收交接。~Starting from Fresnel reflection and the transmission loss of multi-element lenses, derive the residual reflectance of a MgF₂ single layer, a quarter-quarter V-coat and a quarter-half-quarter broadband design from the admittance-matching condition, then cover low-index materials and hot-substrate evaporation, thickness distribution on lenses, the back-surface trap in low-reflectance metrology, incidence-angle and polarization effects, and finally convert residual reflectance into lens ghost and transmission budgets for acceptance handoff.

units.anchor: 多片鏡頭的二十個空氣界面~Twenty air-glass interfaces of a multi-element lens
units.title: Fresnel 反射、穿透率損失與鬼影~Fresnel reflection, transmission loss and ghost images
units.mechanism: 每個空氣與玻璃的界面在正向入射時依 Fresnel 公式反射 [(n − 1)/(n + 1)]² 的能量，BK7 約 4.3%。一支十片透鏡的鏡頭有二十個這樣的界面，未鍍膜時穿透率只剩四成，而且任意兩個界面反射的光會再度抵達像面形成鬼影，其強度正比於兩個反射率的乘積。增透膜的任務就是把每個界面的反射率壓到千分之幾，使穿透率回到九成以上，並把鬼影強度降低兩個數量級；因此增透膜的規格必須從系統的穿透率與雜散光預算倒推，而不是單獨追求某一波長的零反射。~At normal incidence each air-glass interface reflects a fraction [(n − 1)/(n + 1)]² of the energy by the Fresnel equations, about 4.3% for BK7. A ten-element lens has twenty such interfaces, so uncoated it transmits only about forty percent, and light reflected by any two interfaces reaches the image again as a ghost whose intensity scales with the product of the two reflectances. The job of an antireflection film is to push each interface to a few tenths of a percent, restoring transmission above ninety percent and cutting ghost intensity by two orders of magnitude; the coating specification therefore follows from the system's transmission and stray-light budget rather than from zero reflectance at one wavelength.
units.model: BK7 單界面 R = [(1.52 − 1)/(1.52 + 1)]² ≈ 0.0426。二十個界面：未鍍膜穿透率 0.9574²⁰ ≈ 0.42；每面 0.5% 時 0.995²⁰ ≈ 0.905；每面 0.2% 時 0.998²⁰ ≈ 0.961。雙面鬼影相對強度 ≈ R₁·R₂：未鍍膜 0.0426² ≈ 1.8×10⁻³，鍍 0.5% 增透膜後 0.005² = 2.5×10⁻⁵，下降約 72 倍。~A single BK7 interface has R = [(1.52 − 1)/(1.52 + 1)]² ≈ 0.0426. For twenty interfaces the uncoated transmission is 0.9574²⁰ ≈ 0.42; at 0.5% per surface 0.995²⁰ ≈ 0.905; at 0.2% per surface 0.998²⁰ ≈ 0.961. The relative intensity of a two-surface ghost ≈ R₁·R₂: uncoated 0.0426² ≈ 1.8×10⁻³, with 0.5% antireflection 0.005² = 2.5×10⁻⁵, about 72 times lower.
units.verify: 用積分球或準直光束量整支鏡頭在工作波段的穿透率，與每面反射率的乘積模型比較；把鏡頭對準點光源拍攝，量測鬼影相對亮度並用光線追跡的鬼影分析辨認是哪一對面，核對其乘積是否與量到的亮度一致。~Measure the whole lens's in-band transmission with an integrating sphere or a collimated beam and compare with the product-of-surfaces model; photograph a point source through the lens, measure relative ghost brightness and identify the responsible surface pair with ray-trace ghost analysis, checking that the product of their reflectances matches the measured brightness.
units.failure: 只在 550 nm 要求零反射而忽略 450 nm 與 650 nm 的殘餘反射，鏡頭在白光下出現帶紫紅色的鬼影與偏色的穿透率，影像對比在藍與紅端下降。~Demanding zero reflectance at 550 nm while ignoring the residual at 450 and 650 nm produces purple-tinted ghosts and a colour-biased transmission under white light, lowering contrast at the blue and red ends.
units.misconception: 一片鏡片只損失 4%，所以整支鏡頭不鍍膜也只差幾個百分點。~One element loses only 4%, so an uncoated lens is only a few percent worse overall.

units.anchor: MgF₂ 單層與四分之一波雙層 V 膜~MgF₂ single layer and quarter-quarter V-coat
units.title: 導納匹配：單層與 V 形增透膜~Admittance matching: single-layer and V-coat designs
units.mechanism: 增透的條件是讓膜系在入射側的等效導納等於入射介質的折射率。四分之一波單層把基板導納 n_s 轉成 n₁²/n_s，要完全匹配空氣需要 n₁ = √n_s，對 BK7 是 1.23，沒有這麼低的緻密材料，最接近的 MgF₂（1.38）只能把反射率降到 1.3%。雙層四分之一波設計用內層的高折射率把基板導納先抬高、再由外層 MgF₂ 拉回 1，條件是 n₂/n₁ = √n_s；這種設計在單一波長達到近零反射而兩側迅速上升，光譜呈 V 形，因此稱為 V 膜，適合雷射線寬的應用。~The antireflection condition is that the stack's equivalent admittance on the incident side equals the index of the incident medium. A quarter-wave single layer transforms the substrate admittance n_s into n₁²/n_s, so matching air requires n₁ = √n_s, about 1.23 for BK7; no dense material is that low, and the closest, MgF₂ at 1.38, only brings reflectance down to 1.3%. A two-layer quarter-quarter design uses a higher-index inner layer to raise the substrate admittance first and the outer MgF₂ layer to bring it back to 1, with the condition n₂/n₁ = √n_s; it reaches near-zero reflectance at one wavelength and rises quickly on both sides, giving the V-shaped spectrum that names the V-coat and suits laser-line applications.
units.model: 單層四分之一波 MgF₂ 於 BK7：R = [(n_s − n₁²)/(n_s + n₁²)]² = [(1.52 − 1.904)/(1.52 + 1.904)]² ≈ 0.0126。雙層 MgF₂/Al₂O₃（1.38/1.63）：Y = n₁²·n_s/n₂² = 1.904×1.52/2.657 ≈ 1.090，R = [(1 − 1.090)/(1 + 1.090)]² ≈ 0.0018；理想內層 n₂ = 1.38×√1.52 ≈ 1.70 時 R 趨近 0。V 膜在 550 nm 設計下，500 nm 為 0.51%、600 nm 為 0.41%、450 nm 已達 1.6%。~A quarter-wave MgF₂ single layer on BK7: R = [(n_s − n₁²)/(n_s + n₁²)]² = [(1.52 − 1.904)/(1.52 + 1.904)]² ≈ 0.0126. A two-layer MgF₂/Al₂O₃ (1.38/1.63) design: Y = n₁²·n_s/n₂² = 1.904×1.52/2.657 ≈ 1.090 and R = [(1 − 1.090)/(1 + 1.090)]² ≈ 0.0018; with the ideal inner index n₂ = 1.38×√1.52 ≈ 1.70, R approaches 0. Designed for 550 nm, the V-coat reads 0.51% at 500 nm, 0.41% at 600 nm and already 1.6% at 450 nm.
units.verify: 在導納圖上手繪兩層的軌跡：從 n_s 出發，內層四分之一波沿圓弧走到 n₂²/n_s，外層再走到 n₁²n_s/n₂²，確認終點是否落在 1 附近；再把鍍好的 V 膜用分光光度計掃描，確認最低點波長與設計一致、兩側上升速率符合計算曲線。~Trace the two-layer path on an admittance diagram: start at n_s, let the inner quarter wave move along its arc to n₂²/n_s and the outer layer to n₁²n_s/n₂², and check that the end point lands near 1; then scan the deposited V-coat on a spectrophotometer to confirm that the minimum wavelength matches the design and that the rise on both sides follows the calculated curve.
units.failure: 把內外層順序顛倒，MgF₂ 貼在玻璃上而 Al₂O₃ 在最外側，導納終點落在 2 以上，反射率反而比裸玻璃高；或用 V 膜處理白光鏡頭，兩端殘餘反射超過 1.5% 而產生偏色。~Reversing the layer order, with MgF₂ against the glass and Al₂O₃ outermost, lands the admittance above 2 and reflects more than bare glass; using a V-coat on a white-light lens leaves residuals above 1.5% at the band ends and causes colour cast.
units.misconception: 增透膜就是鍍一層折射率低於玻璃的材料，越低越好，厚度不重要。~An antireflection film is just a layer of index lower than glass, the lower the better, with thickness unimportant.

units.anchor: 四分之一／半波／四分之一寬帶膜~Quarter-half-quarter broadband design
units.title: 寬帶增透設計與層數取捨~Broadband antireflection design and layer-count trade-offs
units.mechanism: 寬帶增透的經典三層結構由基板側起為四分之一波 Al₂O₃、半波 ZrO₂ 與四分之一波 MgF₂：半波層在設計波長是「隱形」的，不改變中心反射率，但在偏離中心的波長上它改變導納軌跡的曲率，把兩側的反射率壓平，使可見光全波段平均降到 0.2% 等級。再往上走是四到八層的 TiO₂/SiO₂ 或 Nb₂O₅/SiO₂ 最佳化設計，可把 400 到 700 nm 的平均反射率壓到 0.2% 以下並延伸到近紅外，代價是總厚度、應力與對厚度誤差的敏感度上升。層數的選擇是光譜寬度、角度容忍度、製程能力與成本之間的平衡。~The classic three-layer broadband structure, from the substrate side, is a quarter-wave Al₂O₃, a half-wave ZrO₂ and a quarter-wave MgF₂: the half-wave layer is absentee at the design wavelength and leaves the central reflectance unchanged, but away from centre it alters the curvature of the admittance path and flattens the reflectance on both sides, bringing the visible-band average to the 0.2% level. Beyond that, four- to eight-layer optimised TiO₂/SiO₂ or Nb₂O₅/SiO₂ designs push the 400 to 700 nm average below 0.2% and extend into the near infrared, at the cost of total thickness, stress and sensitivity to thickness error. Choosing the layer count balances spectral width, angular tolerance, process capability and cost.
units.model: 設計波長 520 nm：MgF₂ 四分之一波 520/(4×1.38) ≈ 94.2 nm、ZrO₂（n = 2.05）半波 520/(2×2.05) ≈ 126.8 nm、Al₂O₃ 四分之一波 520/(4×1.63) ≈ 79.8 nm，總厚 ≈ 301 nm。矩陣計算得 R(450) ≈ 0.03%、R(500) ≈ 0.17%、R(600) ≈ 0.04%、R(700) ≈ 0.54%，400 到 700 nm 平均 ≈ 0.20%；同樣基板的單層 MgF₂ 平均為 1.48%。~Design wavelength 520 nm: quarter-wave MgF₂ 520/(4×1.38) ≈ 94.2 nm, half-wave ZrO₂ (n = 2.05) 520/(2×2.05) ≈ 126.8 nm, quarter-wave Al₂O₃ 520/(4×1.63) ≈ 79.8 nm, total ≈ 301 nm. The matrix calculation gives R(450) ≈ 0.03%, R(500) ≈ 0.17%, R(600) ≈ 0.04%, R(700) ≈ 0.54% and a 400 to 700 nm average ≈ 0.20%; a single MgF₂ layer on the same substrate averages 1.48%.
units.verify: 用薄膜軟體把三層設計與一個六層最佳化設計放在同一張圖上比較平均反射率、最大反射率與總厚度；把三層設計的每層厚度各隨機擾動 ±3% 做一百次蒙地卡羅，統計平均反射率的分佈，判斷製程能力是否足以支撐該設計。~Overlay the three-layer design and a six-layer optimised design in thin-film software and compare average reflectance, maximum reflectance and total thickness; perturb each layer of the three-layer design randomly by ±3% in a hundred Monte-Carlo trials and examine the distribution of average reflectance to judge whether the process capability supports the design.
units.failure: 為了追求 0.1% 的平均反射率採用十二層設計，但蒸鍍腔的厚度控制只有 ±3%，量產批次的平均反射率散佈到 0.1% 至 0.6%，良率不到一半，反而不如製程穩定的三層設計。~Chasing a 0.1% average with a twelve-layer design in an evaporation chamber whose thickness control is only ±3% scatters production batches between 0.1% and 0.6% with under fifty percent yield, worse than a process-robust three-layer design.
units.misconception: 半波層對設計波長沒有作用，所以寬帶膜裡的半波層可以省略。~A half-wave layer does nothing at the design wavelength, so it can be dropped from a broadband design.

units.anchor: 熱基板蒸鍍與低折射率膜材~Hot-substrate evaporation and low-index materials
units.title: 低折射率膜材、基板溫度與膜應力~Low-index materials, substrate temperature and film stress
units.mechanism: 增透膜的最外層必須是低折射率材料，可見光區幾乎只有 MgF₂ 與 SiO₂ 可選。MgF₂ 以熱蒸鍍或電子束蒸鍍沉積，基板必須加熱到 250 °C 以上才能得到緻密、附著良好且耐擦拭的膜，冷基板上的 MgF₂ 疏鬆、吸濕且一擦就花。玻璃透鏡可以承受加熱，但塑膠透鏡只能在 80 °C 以下處理，必須改用離子輔助蒸鍍或濺鍍 SiO₂ 並加上附著層。加熱沉積後冷卻時，膜與基板的熱膨脹差異在膜內留下張應力，厚膜系會因此龜裂，這是寬帶多層增透膜總厚度受限的原因之一。~The outermost antireflection layer must be a low-index material, and in the visible there are essentially only MgF₂ and SiO₂. MgF₂ is deposited by thermal or electron-beam evaporation with the substrate heated above 250 °C to obtain a dense, well-adhered, wipe-resistant film; on a cold substrate MgF₂ is porous, hygroscopic and scratches at the first wipe. Glass lenses tolerate heating, but polymer lenses must stay below 80 °C, forcing ion-assisted evaporation or sputtered SiO₂ with an adhesion layer. On cooling after hot deposition the thermal-expansion mismatch between film and substrate leaves tensile stress in the film, which cracks thick stacks and is one reason the total thickness of broadband multilayers is limited.
units.model: 熱失配應力 σ_f ≈ [E_f/(1 − ν_f)]·(α_f − α_s)·ΔT。取 MgF₂ 膜 E_f = 100 GPa、ν_f = 0.3（教學假設）、平均 α_f = 11×10⁻⁶/K，BK7 α_s = 7.1×10⁻⁶/K，由 275 °C 冷卻到 25 °C 的 ΔT = 250 K：σ_f ≈ 1.43×10¹¹ × 3.9×10⁻⁶ × 250 ≈ 1.4×10⁸ Pa ≈ 140 MPa 張應力；對 94 nm 的單層可承受，對 1 µm 以上的多層堆則接近龜裂門檻。~Thermal-mismatch stress σ_f ≈ [E_f/(1 − ν_f)]·(α_f − α_s)·ΔT. Taking a MgF₂ film with E_f = 100 GPa and ν_f = 0.3 (teaching assumptions), mean α_f = 11×10⁻⁶/K, BK7 α_s = 7.1×10⁻⁶/K and ΔT = 250 K for cooling from 275 °C to 25 °C: σ_f ≈ 1.43×10¹¹ × 3.9×10⁻⁶ × 250 ≈ 1.4×10⁸ Pa ≈ 140 MPa tensile, tolerable for a 94 nm single layer but close to the cracking threshold for stacks above 1 µm.
units.verify: 以不同基板溫度（100、200、300 °C）各鍍一片 MgF₂ 試片，用橢偏儀量折射率並以濕度循環觀察光譜位移，確認高溫片的折射率接近 1.38 且位移最小；以薄片基板的曲率變化量膜應力，並做膠帶附著與橡皮擦磨耗測試比較三者。~Deposit MgF₂ witness samples at substrate temperatures of 100, 200 and 300 °C, measure index by ellipsometry and spectral shift under humidity cycling to confirm the hot sample sits near 1.38 with minimal shift; measure film stress from the curvature change of thin substrates and compare the three with tape-adhesion and eraser-abrasion tests.
units.failure: 為了趕工在未達溫的基板上鍍 MgF₂，膜層疏鬆，出廠光譜合格但客戶擦拭後出現霧狀刮痕並在潮濕環境下反射率回升；塑膠鏡片誤用熱製程而翹曲變形。~Depositing MgF₂ on substrates that have not reached temperature to save time gives porous films that pass at shipment but haze and scratch when the customer wipes them and lose antireflection in humid air; a polymer lens run through the hot process warps.
units.misconception: 同一種膜材無論怎麼鍍，折射率與耐久性都一樣。~A given material has the same index and durability however it is deposited.

units.anchor: V-W 反射率附件與背面處理~V-W reflectance accessory and back-surface handling
units.title: 低反射率量測與背面陷阱~Low-reflectance metrology and the back-surface trap
units.mechanism: 量 0.2% 的反射率比量 99% 的反射率困難得多，因為任何雜散光與基板背面的反射都會淹沒訊號。平行平板試片若只有正面鍍膜，背面的 4.3% 反射會穿過正面進入偵測器，量到的總反射率幾乎全是背面貢獻；所以量測前必須把背面磨粗並塗黑，或使用楔形試片把背面反射偏離光路，或以穿透率反推。絕對反射率需要 V-W 型附件，用同一面鏡子在兩種幾何下的比值消去鏡面反射率；光度刻度則以 NIST 可追溯的反射率標準校正。~Measuring 0.2% reflectance is far harder than measuring 99%, because any stray light and the substrate's back-surface reflection swamp the signal. A plane-parallel witness coated only on the front lets the 4.3% back reflection pass through the front into the detector, so the measured total is almost entirely the back surface; the back must therefore be ground and blackened, a wedged witness used to steer the back reflection out of the path, or the front reflectance inferred from transmission. Absolute reflectance needs a V-W accessory, where the ratio of two geometries with the same mirror cancels the mirror's reflectance, and the photometric scale is calibrated with NIST-traceable reflectance standards.
units.model: 正面 V 膜 R_f = 0.18%、背面裸玻璃 R_b = 4.26% 的平板：量到的反射率 ≈ R_f + (1 − R_f)²·R_b ≈ 0.0018 + 0.9964×0.0426 ≈ 4.43%，正面訊號只佔 4%。改量穿透率 T ≈ (1 − R_f)(1 − R_b) ≈ 0.9557，由 T 反推 R_f = 1 − T/(1 − R_b)，當 T 的不確定度為 0.1% 時 R_f 的不確定度約 0.1%，仍不足以驗證 0.18%，所以必須塗黑背面直接量。~A plate with a V-coat front R_f = 0.18% and a bare back R_b = 4.26% measures ≈ R_f + (1 − R_f)²·R_b ≈ 0.0018 + 0.9964×0.0426 ≈ 4.43%, with the front contributing only 4% of the signal. Measuring transmission instead, T ≈ (1 − R_f)(1 − R_b) ≈ 0.9557 and R_f = 1 − T/(1 − R_b); a 0.1% uncertainty in T gives about 0.1% uncertainty in R_f, still too coarse to verify 0.18%, so the back must be blackened and the front measured directly.
units.verify: 同一片試片分別以未處理背面、塗黑背面與楔形試片三種方式量測，確認塗黑後的讀值降到與設計相符的 0.2% 等級且重複性優於 0.03%；以已知反射率的標準片確認光度刻度，並記錄量測光斑大小與入射角。~Measure the same witness three ways, with untreated back, blackened back and as a wedged piece, confirming that the blackened reading drops to the design-level 0.2% with repeatability better than 0.03%; verify the photometric scale with a standard of known reflectance and record the spot size and incidence angle.
units.failure: 未處理背面就量反射率，4.4% 的讀數讓合格的增透膜被判為失敗而整批重鍍；或用穿透率推算，0.1% 的不確定度把 0.18% 與 0.28% 混為一談，無法分辨製程漂移。~Measuring without treating the back yields 4.4% and condemns a good antireflection batch to recoating; inferring from transmission with 0.1% uncertainty cannot tell 0.18% from 0.28% and hides process drift.
units.misconception: 分光光度計讀到的反射率就是鍍膜面的反射率。~The reflectance the spectrophotometer reads is the coated surface's reflectance.

units.anchor: 入射角與厚度誤差的敏感度表~Sensitivity table for angle and thickness error
units.title: 入射角、偏振與厚度公差~Incidence angle, polarization and thickness tolerance
units.mechanism: 增透膜在斜入射時有兩個效應：各層有效光學厚度隨 cosθ 縮短使最低點向短波移動，以及 s 與 p 偏振的導納分離使兩者的殘餘反射率不再相同，s 偏振通常惡化得更快。V 膜因為頻寬窄，對角度與厚度誤差都比寬帶膜敏感；寬帶膜在 30° 內仍能維持接近正向的平均反射率。公差分析要把製程厚度散佈、折射率散佈與使用角度範圍一起放進蒙地卡羅，算出平均反射率的分佈，而不是只看設計點。~At oblique incidence an antireflection film shows two effects: each layer's effective optical thickness shrinks with cosθ, moving the minimum to shorter wavelengths, and the admittances for s and p polarization separate so their residual reflectances differ, with s usually degrading faster. A V-coat, being narrow, is more sensitive to both angle and thickness error than a broadband design, which keeps near-normal average reflectance out to about 30°. Tolerance analysis must put the process thickness spread, index spread and the range of use angles together into a Monte-Carlo run and report the distribution of average reflectance, not just the design point.
units.model: 矩陣計算（550 nm V 膜）：兩層同時薄 5% 時 R 由 0.18% 升到 0.27%，薄 13% 時升到 0.72%。角度：15° 時 R_s = 0.24%、R_p = 0.15%；30° 時 R_s = 0.61%、R_p = 0.13%，平均 0.37%；45° 時 R_s = 2.27%、R_p = 0.20%，平均 1.23%。三層寬帶膜 400 到 700 nm 平均：0° 為 0.20%、30° 為 0.31%、45° 為 0.99%。~Matrix results for the 550 nm V-coat: with both layers 5% thin, R rises from 0.18% to 0.27%, and 13% thin to 0.72%. Angle: at 15°, R_s = 0.24% and R_p = 0.15%; at 30°, R_s = 0.61% and R_p = 0.13%, average 0.37%; at 45°, R_s = 2.27% and R_p = 0.20%, average 1.23%. The three-layer broadband design averages 0.20% at 0°, 0.31% at 30° and 0.99% at 45° over 400 to 700 nm.
units.verify: 在分光光度計的可變角附件上以 s、p 偏振片量 0°、15°、30°、45° 的反射率光譜，與矩陣計算逐點比較，差異應在 0.05% 內；把鏡頭設計中每個面的主光線入射角範圍列表，對照角度敏感度表決定哪些面需要寬帶膜、哪些可用 V 膜。~Measure reflectance spectra at 0°, 15°, 30° and 45° with s and p polarizers on a variable-angle accessory and compare point by point with the matrix calculation, expecting agreement within 0.05%; tabulate the chief-ray incidence-angle range on every surface of the lens design and use the angle-sensitivity table to decide which surfaces need broadband films and which can take a V-coat.
units.failure: 在 0° 驗證合格的 V 膜被用在 40° 入射的分光面，s 偏振殘餘反射超過 1.5%，系統的偏振相關損耗與鬼影同時超標；厚度控制僅 ±5% 的製程生產 V 膜，批次中心波長散佈 ±27 nm，一半的產品在雷射波長上反射率超過 0.3%。~A V-coat verified at 0° used on a surface at 40° incidence leaves more than 1.5% s-polarized residual, failing polarization-dependent loss and ghost limits together; producing V-coats with only ±5% thickness control scatters batch centre wavelengths by ±27 nm so half the parts exceed 0.3% at the laser line.
units.misconception: 增透膜對入射角不敏感，正向量測合格就能用在任何角度。~Antireflection films are insensitive to incidence angle, so passing at normal incidence qualifies any angle.

units.anchor: 透鏡夾具與邊緣厚度衰減~Lens fixture and edge thickness fall-off
units.title: 曲面透鏡上的厚度分佈與鏡頭整合~Thickness distribution on curved lenses and lens integration
units.mechanism: 蒸鍍的膜厚與表面相對於蒸氣流的傾角有關，近似隨 cosφ 下降，陡峭透鏡的邊緣會比中心薄；增透膜的最低點因此在邊緣向短波移動，殘餘反射率沿口徑變化。夾具設計用傾斜的鏡片座、遮罩或把鏡片放在行星轉架的特定半徑來補償，或把設計中心波長略向長波偏移讓邊緣落回波段內。整合到鏡頭時還要處理膠合面（膠的折射率接近玻璃，反射率只有萬分之幾，不需鍍膜）、邊緣塗黑以吸收內反射，以及雷射系統中增透膜的損傷門檻。~Evaporated thickness depends on the surface tilt relative to the vapour stream, falling roughly as cosφ, so the rim of a steep lens receives less than the centre; the antireflection minimum therefore shifts to shorter wavelengths at the rim and the residual varies across the aperture. Fixture design compensates with tilted lens seats, masks or placement at a chosen planetary radius, or the design centre is biased slightly to longer wavelengths so the rim falls back into band. Integration into the lens also handles cemented interfaces, where the cement index is close to glass and reflectance is only a few parts in ten thousand with no coating needed, edge blackening to absorb internal reflections, and, in laser systems, the damage threshold of the antireflection film.
units.model: 邊緣法線與蒸氣流夾角 φ = 30° 的透鏡，邊緣厚度 ≈ cos30° ≈ 0.87 倍中心厚度，即薄 13%；550 nm V 膜在邊緣的最低點移到約 480 nm，550 nm 的殘餘反射率由 0.18% 升到 0.72%（矩陣計算）。膠合面：n = 1.52 與 n = 1.56 的玻璃以 n = 1.54 的膠黏合，各界面 R ≈ [(0.02)/(3.06)]² ≈ 4×10⁻⁵，遠低於任何增透膜。~For a lens whose rim normal makes φ = 30° with the vapour stream, rim thickness ≈ cos30° ≈ 0.87 of centre, 13% thin; the 550 nm V-coat's minimum at the rim moves to about 480 nm and the 550 nm residual rises from 0.18% to 0.72% (matrix calculation). Cemented interface: glasses of n = 1.52 and 1.56 bonded with n = 1.54 cement reflect R ≈ [(0.02)/(3.06)]² ≈ 4×10⁻⁵ at each interface, far below any antireflection film.
units.verify: 在同一片透鏡的中心與邊緣以小光斑反射率附件各量一次，比較最低點波長的位移與 cosφ 模型；在夾具不同半徑放平面見證片，繪出厚度對位置的曲線，調整傾角或遮罩直到邊緣位移小於 3%；鏡頭組裝後量整體穿透率與鬼影，核對整合預算。~Measure the lens centre and rim with a small-spot reflectance accessory and compare the minimum-wavelength shift with the cosφ model; place flat witnesses at several fixture radii, plot thickness against position and adjust tilt or masks until the rim shift is below 3%; after assembly measure total transmission and ghosts to close the integration budget.
units.failure: 陡峭非球面以平放的夾具鍍 V 膜，邊緣最低點偏到 480 nm，在雷射波長邊緣環帶反射率 0.7%，形成環狀鬼影；或在膠合面上多鍍增透膜，反而因膠與膜的折射率差增加反射並造成膠合應力。~A steep asphere coated flat in the fixture gets its rim minimum at 480 nm, a 0.7% rim annulus at the laser wavelength and a ring ghost; adding an antireflection film to a cemented interface raises reflection through the index step between cement and film and stresses the bond.
units.misconception: 透鏡在腔內轉動，膜厚在整個曲面上自然均勻。~Because the lens rotates in the chamber the film is naturally uniform over the whole curved surface.

units.anchor: 增透膜規格表與鏡頭穿透率預算~Antireflection specification sheet and lens transmission budget
units.title: 規格換算、耐久等級與交接~Specification conversion, durability class and handoff
units.mechanism: 增透膜的規格應寫成「在指定波段與角度範圍內的平均與最大反射率」，並註明單面或雙面、基板折射率、偏振，以及耐久等級：依 ISO 9211 或軍規的磨耗、附著、濕熱與鹽霧序列。驗收時用塗黑背面的見證片量反射率，並把每面的實測值代回系統模型計算鏡頭穿透率與主要鬼影，與系統預算比較。交接資料包括各面的膜型（V 膜或寬帶）、設計波長、見證片光譜、耐久測試結果與批號，使鏡頭裝配與雷射系統端能追溯每個面的狀態與清潔方式限制。~An antireflection specification should read as average and maximum reflectance within a stated band and angle range, with single- or double-sided, substrate index, polarization and durability class per ISO 9211 or military abrasion, adhesion, humidity and salt-fog sequences. Acceptance measures witnesses with blackened backs and feeds each surface's measured value back into the system model to compute lens transmission and the main ghosts against the system budget. The handoff lists each surface's film type (V-coat or broadband), design wavelength, witness spectrum, durability results and batch number so lens assembly and laser-system users can trace every surface's state and cleaning limits.
units.model: 十片鏡頭、二十面，其中十六面鍍寬帶膜平均 0.25%，四面陡峭面因邊緣效應取 0.5%：穿透率 ≈ 0.9975¹⁶ × 0.995⁴ ≈ 0.961 × 0.980 ≈ 0.942，再乘玻璃內部吸收 0.98 得 0.92，若系統預算要求 ≥ 0.90 則合格。最亮鬼影來自兩個 0.5% 的面：2.5×10⁻⁵，相對未鍍膜的 1.8×10⁻³ 下降 72 倍，符合雜散光預算 ≤ 5×10⁻⁵。~A ten-element lens with twenty surfaces, sixteen coated broadband at 0.25% average and four steep surfaces taken at 0.5% for rim effects: transmission ≈ 0.9975¹⁶ × 0.995⁴ ≈ 0.961 × 0.980 ≈ 0.942, times 0.98 for internal glass absorption gives 0.92, passing a system budget of ≥ 0.90. The brightest ghost comes from two 0.5% surfaces: 2.5×10⁻⁵, 72 times below the uncoated 1.8×10⁻³ and within a stray-light budget of ≤ 5×10⁻⁵.
units.verify: 以第二台分光光度計複測見證片，差異需小於 0.05%；核對規格表每一項（波段、角度、偏振、耐久等級）都有對應量測紀錄；把見證片做完整耐久序列後再量一次光譜，確認平均反射率變化小於 0.1%，並把整支鏡頭的穿透率實測值與預算表並列。~Re-measure witnesses on a second spectrophotometer, requiring agreement within 0.05%; check that every specification line (band, angle, polarization, durability class) has a matching measurement record; run the witnesses through the full durability sequence and re-measure, confirming the average reflectance changes by less than 0.1%, and place the measured lens transmission beside the budget table.
units.failure: 規格只寫「R < 0.5%」而未指明波段與角度，供應商在 550 nm 正向交貨合格，鏡頭在 420 nm、35° 的面上殘餘反射 2%，藍光鬼影超標；缺少耐久等級，軟質 MgF₂ 膜被客戶以乾布擦拭後刮花。~A specification reading only R < 0.5% without band or angle passes at 550 nm normal incidence while a surface used at 420 nm and 35° leaves 2% residual and a blue ghost over budget; without a durability class a soft MgF₂ film is scratched when the customer wipes it with a dry cloth.
units.misconception: 增透膜越透明越好，規格只需要一個反射率上限。~An antireflection film only needs to be as transparent as possible, so one reflectance ceiling is specification enough.

example: 增透膜設計與整合練習：BK7（n_s = 1.52）透鏡，工作波段 450 到 650 nm，主光線入射角 0 到 30°。先評估單層 MgF₂：R(550) = [(1.52 − 1.38²)/(1.52 + 1.38²)]² = [(1.52 − 1.904)/3.424]² ≈ 0.0126，400 到 700 nm 平均 1.48%，不符 0.5% 的要求。改用四分之一／半波／四分之一設計（520 nm）：MgF₂ 94.2 nm、ZrO₂ 126.8 nm、Al₂O₃ 79.8 nm，矩陣計算 400 到 700 nm 平均 0.20%，30° 時 0.31%，仍在 0.5% 內。二十面中十六面以此膜計 0.25%、四面陡峭面計 0.5%，鏡頭穿透率 ≈ 0.9975¹⁶ × 0.995⁴ × 0.98 ≈ 0.92，最亮雙面鬼影 0.005² = 2.5×10⁻⁵。製程公差：蒙地卡羅各層 ±3% 厚度擾動一千次後平均反射率落在 0.19% 到 0.28%，良率 100%；邊緣傾角 30° 的面厚度薄 13%，需把夾具傾斜或把設計中心上移 5% 補償。數值皆為教學假設，不代表任何產品規格。~Antireflection design and integration exercise: a BK7 lens (n_s = 1.52) working from 450 to 650 nm with chief-ray incidence from 0 to 30°. First evaluate single-layer MgF₂: R(550) = [(1.52 − 1.38²)/(1.52 + 1.38²)]² = [(1.52 − 1.904)/3.424]² ≈ 0.0126 and a 400 to 700 nm average of 1.48%, failing the 0.5% requirement. Switch to a quarter-half-quarter design at 520 nm: MgF₂ 94.2 nm, ZrO₂ 126.8 nm, Al₂O₃ 79.8 nm; the matrix calculation gives a 400 to 700 nm average of 0.20% and 0.31% at 30°, still within 0.5%. Counting sixteen of twenty surfaces at 0.25% and four steep surfaces at 0.5%, lens transmission ≈ 0.9975¹⁶ × 0.995⁴ × 0.98 ≈ 0.92 and the brightest two-surface ghost is 0.005² = 2.5×10⁻⁵. Process tolerance: a thousand-trial Monte-Carlo run with ±3% thickness perturbation per layer keeps the average reflectance between 0.19% and 0.28%, full yield; a surface with a 30° rim tilt receives 13% less thickness and needs a tilted fixture or a 5% upward bias of the design centre to compensate. All values are teaching assumptions, not any product specification.
history: 1817 年 Fraunhofer 觀察到表面風化的玻璃反射較弱，1904 年 Harold Dennis Taylor 取得以化學處理鏡片降低反射的專利，1935 年 Alexander Smakula 在蔡司取得真空蒸鍍氟化物增透膜的專利並在二次大戰期間用於軍用光學，1938 年 Katharine Blodgett 以單分子膜展示「不反光玻璃」。1940 年代末的雙層設計與 1950 至 60 年代 Cox 與 Hass 等人的四分之一／半波／四分之一寬帶膜奠定了今天多層增透膜的基礎，1970 年代 Clapham 與 Hutley 提出仿蛾眼的次波長結構，近年的電漿蝕刻奈米結構與最佳化多層設計把平均反射率推到 0.1% 等級。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯。~Fraunhofer observed in 1817 that weathered glass reflects less; Harold Dennis Taylor patented a chemical lens treatment to reduce reflection in 1904; Alexander Smakula at Zeiss patented vacuum-evaporated fluoride antireflection coatings in 1935, used on military optics during the Second World War; and Katharine Blodgett demonstrated non-reflecting glass with monomolecular films in 1938. Two-layer designs of the late 1940s and the quarter-half-quarter broadband films of Cox, Hass and others in the 1950s and 1960s laid the foundation of today's multilayer antireflection coatings, Clapham and Hutley proposed moth-eye sub-wavelength structures in 1973, and recent plasma-etched nanostructures and optimised multilayers push average reflectance to the 0.1% level. This course reconstructs only public principles and engineering logic.
